Mia Chen: Heads-up: product wants to flip the default policy sampling mode to 'console-aware' for GA rollout. worried about SDK churn — this could change per-request telemetry and quota attribution. we need a plan.
Ashok Patel: Can you sketch the behavior change? is it just sampling flag propagation or header rename?
Mia Chen: It's two parts: 1) server-side will prefer console-derived sampling hints when present, 2) SDKs currently synthesize a sampling header `x-rd-sample` with a boolean. new behavior expects `x-rd-sample` to be an object like `{mode: "console", weight: 0.2}`.
Loren Singh: Oof that's a breaking shape change for Python/TS/Go. binary-compatible clients will just forward string -> server will start rejecting on strict parsing.
Priya Desai: We can do a graceful acceptance window: server accepts both old boolean and new object for 90 days and logs a deprecation metric. But devex/SDKs should ship a non-breaking shim that continues to emit boolean unless opt-in.
Ryan O'Neill: Agreed. Devex UX question: console needs a toggle per-tenant to opt into "console-aware sampling" and show examples for SDKs. The console tile currently displays a single sampling rate; we should add an annotation when shim is active.
Mia Chen: Action items: (1) platform: accept both shapes + deprecation metric + warning in logs, (2) sdks: add opt-in flag and a helper to emit new object shape, (3) devex: console toggle + migration docs. timeline: two weeks?
Ashok Patel: On the SDK side: propose API like `client.setSampling({mode: 'console', weight: 0.2})` and `client.setSampling({legacy: true})` for old behavior. We'll signal deprecation with telemetry event `sdk.sampling.shape` when emitting legacy form.
Priya Desai: Docs snippet for Python: ```py
# opt into new console-aware sampling
client = RedwoodClient(...)
client.set_sampling(mode='console', weight=0.2)
```
Loren Singh: TS example: ```ts
// default unchanged; opt-in explicitly
const c = new Redwood({})
c.setSampling({ mode: 'console', weight: 0.2 })
```
Ryan O'Neill: Console UX: add a hover tooltip "legacy shim active" and a migration checklist: SDK patch versions, expected log lines, timeline. We'll also add a per-tenant canary switch.
Mia Chen: Can we avoid a major semver bump? keep API additive. patch/minor only.
Ashok Patel: Yes, we can make it additive. We'll add `setSampling` as a minor release. For Go we expose `SetSampling(ctx, opts)`. No breaking changes.
Priya Desai: Who owns the migration doc? I'll draft it and link to a sample troubleshooting playbook.
Loren Singh: I'll open PRs: py #482, ts #783, go #129. I'll coordinate CHANGELOG entries.
Mia Chen: Platform: please add acceptance for both shapes and emit metric `policy.sampling.shape.v1_migration` with counts. Also add an error log that is only a WARN when legacy is seen after grace period.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy started for policy-service v3.14 -> env: staging. link: <https://ci.redwood/d/1234> :rocket:
Ryan O'Neill: Nice. Let's lock the rollout cadence: 2w acceptance window + 30d opt-out grace. update stakeholders by EOD.
Mia Chen: Thanks—I'll sync with support and schedule a short blameless postmortem playbook in case tenants see attribution shifts. :thumbsup:
